```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r instalar, eval=FALSE}
BiocManager::install("fgsea")
install.packages(c("msigdbr", "ggplot2", "patchwork"))
```

```{r libraries}
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
stopifnot(file.exists("../output/brain_referencia.RData"))
load("../output/brain_referencia.RData")
dir.create("../output/opcional3", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r cargas_pca}
cargas <- referencia$loadings[, 1:10]
anotacion <- referencia$genes[match(rownames(cargas), referencia$genes$feature), ]
ids <- sub("[.][0-9]+$", "", as.character(anotacion$Ensembl))
cat("Genes en el PCA:", nrow(cargas), "\nPC:", ncol(cargas), "\n")
head(cbind(anotacion[, c("feature", "Ensembl", "Symbol")], cargas[, 1:2]))
write.table(cbind(anotacion[, c("feature", "Ensembl", "Symbol")], cargas),
            "../output/opcional3/loadings_PC1_PC10.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r gobp_mouse}
gobp <- msigdbr(db_species = "MM", species = "Mus musculus", collection = "M5", subcollection = "GO:BP")
gobp <- gobp[!is.na(gobp$ensembl_gene) & gobp$ensembl_gene != "", ]
conjuntos <- lapply(split(gobp$ensembl_gene, gobp$gs_name), unique)
cat("Versión MSigDB:", unique(gobp$db_version), "\nConjuntos GO:BP:", length(conjuntos), "\n")
cat("Genes del PCA presentes en GO:BP:", sum(ids %in% gobp$ensembl_gene), "de", length(ids), "\n")
gobp_mouse <- list(version = unique(gobp$db_version), pathways = conjuntos)
save(gobp_mouse, file = "../output/opcional3/gobp_mouse.RData", compress = "xz")
```

```{r gsea_por_pc}
rankings <- resultados <- list()
for (pc in 1:10) {
  nombre_pc <- paste0("PC", pc)
  ranking <- setNames(cargas[, pc], ids)
  ranking <- ranking[is.finite(ranking) & !is.na(names(ranking)) & names(ranking) != ""]
  ranking <- ranking[order(abs(ranking), decreasing = TRUE)]
  ranking <- ranking[!duplicated(names(ranking))]
  ranking <- sort(ranking, decreasing = TRUE)
  rankings[[nombre_pc]] <- ranking
  write.table(data.frame(Ensembl = names(ranking), peso = unname(ranking)),
              paste0("../output/opcional3/", nombre_pc, "_ranking.tsv"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
  set.seed(42 + pc)
  resultado <- as.data.frame(fgseaMultilevel(pathways = conjuntos, stats = ranking,
                                           minSize = 15, maxSize = 500, eps = 0, nPermSimple = 10000,
                                           BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()))
  resultado$PC <- nombre_pc
  resultados[[nombre_pc]] <- resultado[order(resultado$padj), ]
  cat(nombre_pc, ":", length(ranking), "genes;", sum(resultado$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      "términos con FDR por PC < 0.05;", sum(is.na(resultado$pval)), "términos sin p-value estimable\n")
}
```

```{r guardar_gsea}
tabla <- do.call(rbind, resultados)
tabla$padj_global <- p.adjust(tabla$pval, method = "BH")
tabla$PC <- factor(tabla$PC, levels = paste0("PC", 1:10))
gsea_pca <- list(rankings = rankings, resultados = resultados, tabla = tabla,
                 version_msigdb = unique(gobp$db_version))
save(gsea_pca, file = "../output/opcional3/gsea_PC1_PC10.RData", compress = "xz")
exportar <- tabla
exportar$leadingEdge <- vapply(exportar$leadingEdge, paste, character(1), collapse = ";")
write.table(exportar, "../output/opcional3/GSEA_GOBP_PC1_PC10.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
head(tabla[order(tabla$padj_global), c("PC", "pathway", "NES", "pval", "padj", "padj_global", "size")], 20)
```

```{r resumen_gsea, fig.width=14, fig.height=18}
significativos <- tabla[!is.na(tabla$padj_global) & tabla$padj_global < 0.05, ]
significativos <- significativos[order(significativos$padj_global), ]
if (nrow(significativos) > 0) {
  mostrar <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(significativos, significativos$PC, drop = TRUE), head, 5))
  mostrar$termino <- substr(gsub("_", " ", sub("^GOBP_", "", mostrar$pathway)), 1, 55)
  grilla <- ggplot(mostrar, aes(NES, reorder(termino, NES), color = -log10(padj_global), size = size)) +
    geom_point() + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey60") +
    facet_wrap(~PC, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) + theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "NES", y = NULL, color = "-log10(FDR global)", size = "Genes")
  print(grilla)
  ggsave("../output/opcional3/resumen_GSEA.png", grilla, width = 14, height = 18, dpi = 150)
} else {
  cat("No se encontraron términos GO:BP con FDR global < 0.05. Revisar la tabla completa.\n")
}
```

```{r curva_enriquecimiento, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
pc_ejemplo <- "PC1"
tabla_pc <- resultados[[pc_ejemplo]]
if (nrow(tabla_pc) > 0 && is.finite(tabla_pc$padj[1])) {
  via <- tabla_pc$pathway[1]
  plotEnrichment(conjuntos[[via]], rankings[[pc_ejemplo]]) +
    labs(title = paste(pc_ejemplo, via), subtitle = paste("FDR por PC =", signif(tabla_pc$padj[1], 3)))
}
```
